result.reason: The clause includes the preferred frequency, notice, business-hours, independent-auditor, confidentiality, and no-system-access protections. However, it makes Vendor bear audit costs in all cases and omits the required cost-shifting exception where underpayment exceeds 5%. It also adds scope, non-disruption, and off-site-review restrictions beyond the stated playbook requirements, so it is not strictly minimal. The operative language otherwise preserves a meaningful compliance-audit right and is professionally drafted; the margin comment does not cure the omitted cost exception.
